title: "Curriculum Vitae"
# The contact email (owner, 2026-09-26), shown on this page and in the PDF header.
cv-email: rakeen.tanvir@duke.edu
aliases:
  - /cv/
  - /resume.html
  - /talks/
  - /teaching/
format:
  html:
    format-links: false
    # The year column (Pandoc definition lists); the PDF gets it from the terms rule below.
    css: cv.css
  typst:
    # Rendered to _site/CV_RakeenTanvir.pdf, then copied (moved, in CI) to _site/files/ by
    # _scripts/copy-cv-pdf.ts.
    output-file: CV_RakeenTanvir.pdf
    title: ""
    papersize: us-letter
    margin:
      x: 0.9in
      y: 0.75in
    fontsize: 11pt
    # Libertinus Serif is built into Typst, so the PDF is identical on Windows and in CI.
    mainfont: "Libertinus Serif"
    number-sections: false
    page-numbering: ""
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        // The PDF's metadata (the title a PDF viewer shows); the page itself has no title block.
        #set document(title: "Rakeen Tanvir – Curriculum Vitae", author: "Rakeen Tanvir")
        // Sticky: a section heading never ends a page without its first entry.
        #show heading.where(level: 1): it => block(above: 1.4em, below: 0.75em, width: 100%, sticky: true)[
          #set text(size: 1.05em, weight: "bold")
          #smallcaps(it.body)
          #v(-0.6em)
          #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt)
        ]
        #show link: set text(fill: rgb("#1a4f8b"))
        // Dated entries are Pandoc definition lists: the date in a left column (lining, tabular
        // figures, so the years line up), the entry beside it. An entry never splits across pages.
        #show terms: it => grid(
          columns: (5.6em, 1fr),
          column-gutter: 0.9em,
          row-gutter: 0.65em,
          ..it.children.map(item => (
            grid.cell(breakable: false, text(number-type: "lining", number-width: "tabular", item.term)),
            grid.cell(breakable: false, item.description),
          )).flatten()
        )
---
